_about: Golden cases for the poppy.json check of @geosuite/poppy-json (src/check.js) and GeoSuite's audit (backend/services/ingestion/personal_agent_protocol.py), draft 0.3 of the Personal Agent Protocol. Both repos run every case; GeoSuite keeps a byte-identical copy in backend/tests/fixtures/poppy_json_golden.json. Field names are the audit's (snake_case); the JS test maps them. A route answers with {status (default 200), json | body | oversize (a JSON body over 256 KB), location} or raises ('fetch' or 'timeout'); any other URL answers 404.

validate_cases.name: a complete document without sign-in is valid
a declared https issuer is reported
the domain must be the host that served the file
hosts are compared ignoring case
a 0.2 file is not usable
a 0.1 file with the old sign-in fields is not usable
a new major version is not usable
a patch number keeps the major.minor
a version without a dot is missing
a document without channels is invalid
an issuer that is not https is flagged
an API without a description is invalid
a JSON array is not a document
an empty list is not an organization name
an empty object is not an organization name
an API type that is not a string is not counted
unknown API types are skipped, not flagged
a space in the endpoint host is not a URL
a broken IPv6 endpoint is not a URL
a conversation endpoint on http is flagged
a browser session endpoint on http is flagged
a browser session alone is a channel
an empty web block is a channel
the mediated sign-in extension is a sign-in type
signed_in access is reported
an unknown access value is ignored
sign-in turned off cannot ask for signed_in access
sign-in turned off cannot offer mediated sign-in
sign-in turned off alone is valid

metadata_cases.name: metadata must name the issuer and list the domain
a bare host in protected_resources does not count
a www host is another resource
metadata need https token and revocation endpoints
an http token endpoint does not count
the authorization code grant needs an authorization endpoint
the device code grant needs a device authorization endpoint
refresh_token alone needs only the token and revocation endpoints

probe_cases.name: a company with no sign-in is valid when the domain has no protected resource metadata
a company with sign-in is valid when discovery and metadata agree
the issuer comes from the protected resource metadata, auth.issuer is optional
sign-in types come from the grant types, mediated from the extension
sign-in turned off reports no sign-in types
an empty list of authorization servers means no issuer
a declared issuer with no protected resource metadata is flagged
signed_in access with no issuer is flagged
mediated sign-in with no issuer is flagged
a protected resource metadata error is not a missing issuer
a protected resource metadata timeout is not a missing issuer
protected resource metadata that are not JSON are invalid
protected resource metadata for another resource are invalid
authorization servers that are not https are invalid
two authorization servers need auth.issuer to pick one
auth.issuer picks one of two authorization servers
auth.issuer must be one of the authorization servers
unreachable issuer metadata make the file invalid
issuer metadata that are not JSON are invalid
issuer metadata over 256 KB are invalid
issuer metadata problems are reported
an issuer with a path is looked up after the well-known segment
the file speaks for the host it was served from after redirects
a domain that is not the final host is a mismatch
a redirect through http is flagged
a redirect off the well-known path is flagged
a 0.2 file stops before discovery
a 404 is a missing file, with its status
an HTML page answered with 200 is a missing file
a network error never throws
a timeout reads as a timeout
a file over 256 KB is too large
